tweet.text:
🚨 OpenAI is correcting Codex usage limits.

According to an email I just received from OpenAI, some GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol requests, including Ultrafast mode, were previously consuming less usage allowance than intended.

Following the correction, users may hit their usage limits sooner, while subscription prices remain unchanged.

Essentially, same price, less effective usage.

OpenAI has not disclosed how much faster the allowance will be consumed.
